g.text: U2 pulls CTRL low during overvoltage.

g.desc: U2 pulls CTRL low during overvoltage.

g.text: I_LED = 0.200 V / 5.23 ohm = 38.24 mA nominal; target <40 mA. LEDK connects to U1.FB and R7 only.

g.desc: I_LED = 0.200 V / 5.23 ohm = 38.24 mA nominal; target <40 mA. LEDK connects to U1.FB and R7 only.

g.text: External regulated 5 V is mandatory. J4.1=GND / J4.2=+5V. No connection to host +5 V or host LEDA/LEDK.

g.desc: External regulated 5 V is mandatory. J4.1=GND / J4.2=+5V. No connection to host +5 V or host LEDA/LEDK.

g.text: LED load: 21.6-27.2 V at 40 mA | Separate regulated boost supply | Common GND with F469

g.desc: LED load: 21.6-27.2 V at 40 mA | Separate regulated boost supply | Common GND with F469

g.text: 01 / INPUT POWER - FUSE, REVERSE BLOCK & ISOLATION

g.desc: 01 / INPUT POWER - FUSE, REVERSE BLOCK & ISOLATION

g.text: REV I VALIDATION: OVP nominal = 1.242 x (1 + 221k/10k) = 28.690 V. HOST_3V3 must settle >=10 ms before PWM.

g.desc: REV I VALIDATION: OVP nominal = 1.242 x (1 + 221k/10k) = 28.690 V. HOST_3V3 must settle >=10 ms before PWM.

g.text: Open-load can hiccup; measure peak <30 V. CTRL shutdown is not immediate (2.5 ms); <30 V OVP is NOT certified.

g.desc: Open-load can hiccup; measure peak <30 V. CTRL shutdown is not immediate (2.5 ms); <30 V OVP is NOT certified.

g.text: Do not hot-plug. Turn PWM off before panel disconnect. Verify SW loop, GND return, EMI and thermal.

g.desc: Do not hot-plug. Turn PWM off before panel disconnect. Verify SW loop, GND return, EMI and thermal.

g.text: Fuse is not an overvoltage limiter. Component values, LED current and protection require prototype validation.

g.desc: Fuse is not an overvoltage limiter. Component values, LED current and protection require prototype validation.
